# `hk agent hooks`

- **Usage:** `hk agent hooks <--target <TARGET>>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print a hook configuration for an agent or editor

## Flags

- **`--target <TARGET>`** — Agent or editor to generate the hook configuration for

  **Choices:** `codex`, `claude-code`, `vscode`

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Print a hook or task snippet to review and merge into your host configuration.

```sh
hk agent hooks --target claude-code
hk agent hooks --target vscode
```
